dataset.product: Suomi NPP VIIRS I-band 375 m Active Fire Archive
dataset.units: hotspot_detections (375 m VIIRS pixel-center thermal anomalies per overpass)
dataset.unit_caveat: Counts represent satellite hotspot detections (repeated overpasses and multi-pixel clusters included), NEVER unique fires, forest loss area, or burned hectares.

missing_observation_gaps.gap_explanation: All 184 Mar-Aug dates exist in 2019, 2020, and 2021. In 2022, 16 dates have zero detections across all of Ukraine: 2022-03-05 (1 day) and a continuous 15-day blackout from 2022-07-27 through 2022-08-10 aligning with the documented NASA Suomi NPP spacecraft anomaly/outage. Because August 2022 contains only 21/31 observed days (and July 26/31), raw 2022 late-summer counts understate activity and must be read alongside detections_per_observed_day.

repeated_detections_summary.definition: Cells rounded to 0.01 deg (~1.1 km N-S x ~0.72 km E-W at 49N). Multiple rows in one cell/day occur from multi-pixel fire fronts, swath overlap, or twice-daily D/N S-NPP overpasses.

reasons_not_assessed: Only n = 1 post-invasion season (March-August 2022) is observed across 3 baseline years (2019-2021).

Satellite hotspot pixels exhibit strong spatial and temporal clustering (repeated multi-day detections over single burning areas or static plants), invalidating independent-event Poisson/t-test p-values.
2022 contains a 16-day observation blackout (Jul 27 - Aug 10 S-NPP outage + Mar 05), breaking equal seasonal exposure.
No meteorological covariates (drought/VPD, wind, temperature, cloud fraction) or external validated controls are included to isolate conflict from weather or agricultural burning shifts.

detection_location_map.data_source: clean FIRMS SV-C2 detections + 0.25-deg grid shifts

limitations: Hotspot counts measure 375 m pixel-center thermal anomalies per overpass, NOT number of fires, forest loss area, or burned hectares.
Repeated detections (~30-38% of 0.01-deg cells have multiple detections) amplify slow-moving or persistent sources across swath overlaps and day/night overpasses.
FIRMS type=2 static industrial detections (steelworks/flares, e.g., Mariupol & Kryvyi Rih) plunged -77.5% in 2022; including type=2 mixes industrial shutdowns with open fires.
Suomi NPP suffered a 15-day outage (2022-07-27 to 2022-08-10; plus zero detections on 2022-03-05), reducing August 2022 to 21/31 observed days.

Proposed study/reference boxes inside Ukraine are candidates for team agreement and are NOT validated causal controls; pre-2022 fire regimes differ sharply between Western/Northern spring burning and Eastern/Southern summer steppe burning.
No meteorological controls (drought, soil moisture, temperature, cloud obstruction) or causal attribution models are included.
